title: 30A Magical Place | Real Joy
meta_description: Why Guests Love This Home* Walk to Dune Allen Regional Beach Access* 4 Bikes Included – cruise Scenic 30A with ease* Beach chairs, umbrellas + boogie boards ready to go* Relaxing community pool just steps away* Walk to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery + Redfish Vi
description_expanded: Why Guests Love This Home* Walk to Dune Allen Regional Beach Access* 4 Bikes Included – cruise Scenic 30A with ease* Beach chairs, umbrellas + boogie boards ready to go* Relaxing community pool just steps away* Walk to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery + Redfish Village* 2 miles to Gulf Place Town Center (west)* 2 miles to Grayton Beach State Park (east)* Professionally managed with 24/7 guest support*Age Requirement: Must be 25+ to book. No exceptions.*Snowbirds Welcome! Monthly winter stays (Jan–Feb) available, call for details.*Welcome to 30A Magical Place, a newer coastal retreat tucked inside the peaceful Serenity at Dune Allen community. With over 2,000 sq ft of thoughtfully designed space, this 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath home blends comfort, style, and unbeatable location. Start your mornings on the charming front porch with coffee and salty air. Spend your days biking to the beach, floating in emerald water, or lounging poolside. Come home to open-concept living, a fully stocked kitchen, and plenty of space for everyone to unwind. This isn’t just a place to stay, it’s where your favorite beach memories begin. Ready to book your slice of 30A magic? -Sleeping Arrangements-1st FloorPrimary Suite: King Bed + private ensuite bath2nd FloorGuest Bedroom 1: King BedGuest Bedroom 2: Queen BedLoft area: Perfect for movie nights or quiet reading timeSerenity at Dune Allen sits on the quiet west end of Scenic 30A, close to everything, but away from the crowds. Hop on the paved bike path and explore beach towns, boutiques, and local dining. Location, Location, Location!!You’re minutes from:Grayton Beach State ParkSeaside, WaterColor, Seacrest, and Rosemary BeachGulf Place shopping + diningLocal favorites like Blue Mountain Beach Creamery-Adventure Awaits: Sea Turtle ReefSnorkelers will love the nearby Sea Turtle Reef, located just offshore near Grayton Beach. This artificial reef has become a thriving marine habitat perfect for spotting fish and sea life. For the best experience, bring a paddleboard or kayak and always monitor sea conditions.-Why 30A?Sugar-white sand. Emerald green water. A laid-back luxury vibe you can’t replicate anywhere else. Bike rides at sunset. Ice cream after dinner. Barefoot beach mornings. Read less
